# An HKD invoice with a tax entry: the same shape as the USD one, in a currency worth far
# less than a Canadian dollar.
#
# 333.33 HKD of consulting at 10% tax, posted at 0.1754 CAD/HKD. The CAD
# figures come from the HKD ones — 333.33 × 0.1754 is 58.4661, which the cent
# holds as 58.47, and 33.33 × 0.1754 is 5.846, held as 5.85 — so each carries
# up to half a cent of CAD rounding.
#
# Half a CAD cent is a fifth of a HKD cent going the other way: divide 58.47
# back by the rate and it says 333.35 HKD, not the 333.33 the ledger carries.
# A check that reads a rate backwards out of the figures it produced calls
# every one of these books wrong — the smaller the currency, the more
# certainly — which is one of the reasons no such check is made. Rates run
# forward: the file states one, the figure follows, and the effective rate the
# ledger carries afterwards is the rounding, not a discrepancy.
#
# What this fixture produces: one basis, at the aggregate of the two CAD
# lines, and a clean `--verify-costs`.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_verify_costs.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable HKD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax:Sales Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

taxtable "Sales Tax"
	entry:
		account: "Liabilities:Tax:Sales Tax"
		rate: 10.0%
		type: PERCENT

customer "C-HK"
	name: "HK Customer"
	currency: HKD

invoice "INV-HKD-TAXED"
	customer_id: "C-HK"
	currency: HKD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 333.33
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "Sales Tax"
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable HKD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-HKD-TAXED"
		accumulate: true
